reviews.title: Defective Stick
reviews.comment:
One of the sticks I got worked just fine. The other would cause my games, and often the entire computer, to crash. MemTest86 and MemTest86+ found no errors, but still, DWM (among other things) would fail and take the computer with it.
Games would close after about 15 minutes. Or the entire computer would reboot itself. Sometimes it would briefly show a Blue Screen of Death first.
I took one RAM stick out, and the problems stopped. Swapped it for the other stick, and the crashes continued. I'll be returning these. If you buy them and have the same problem, remember the RAM is suspect even if MemTest finds no errors.
reviews.author: Joshua Taylor
